categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Troop Soft Copy Cost

modifiers.value: This unit has more than one Leader attached. It may have only one attached Leader. Remove or move one of the attached Leaders.

sharedSelectionEntries.comment:
LOADOUT REV15: fixed five-model presentation compiled for listbuilder clarity. Chaos Champion has a mandatory Power Weapon / Power Fist / Daemon Hammer choice and a mandatory Bolt Pistol / Plasma Pistol choice; the player-facing Bolt Pistol label intentionally shortens the source Champion Bolt Pistol name. Legionary 2-3 share one two-model package choice: 2x Boltgun & Combat Knife or 2x Chainsword & Bolt Pistol. Those package buttons carry hidden semantic child items so one player-facing choice can still represent the separate underlying weapons. Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 each choose Special Weapon Legionary, Heavy Weapon Legionary, or Butcher Legionary. Special Weapon Legionaries retain Combat Knife and choose Meltagun / Plasmagun / Flamer; Heavy Weapon Legionaries retain Combat Knife and choose Autocannon / Heavy Bolter / Lascannon / Missile Launcher / Reaper Chaincannon; Butcher Legionaries retain Combat Knife and carry Heavy Chain Axe. The uncommon source-legal fallback where Legionary 4 or 5 remains a normal Boltgun/Combat Knife model is intentionally not given its own button under the companion-listbuilder presentation policy. Chaos Influence is an optional +10 choice between Khornate Bloodlust, Tzeentian Sorcery, Nurglite Contagion, and Slaaneshi Grace. Replenished Ranks zeroes both the root Legionaries cost and any selected Chaos Influence descendant cost when this unit is the Chaos Apothecary's host.
SHARED LOADOUT PACKAGES REV25: Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 now represent every weapon-plus-Combat-Knife state as one shared meaningful package. Special Weapon Legionaries use Meltagun & Combat Knife / Plasmagun & Combat Knife / Flamer & Combat Knife; Heavy Weapon Legionaries use the equivalent Autocannon / Heavy Bolter / Lascannon / Missile Launcher / Reaper Chaincannon & Combat Knife packages; Butcher Legionaries use Heavy Chain Axe & Combat Knife. Each exact package is shared between Legionary 4 and Legionary 5. Existing weapon selection IDs are retained as link IDs; historical standalone Combat Knife IDs remain hidden and optional. Chaos Champion, Legionary 2-3, Chaos Influence, attachments, points, and all other Legionary mechanics are unchanged.

sharedSelectionEntries.name: Chaos Terminators

categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Other Soft Copy Cost

sharedSelectionEntries.comment:
LOADOUT REV17: the two-model Chaos Terminator unit is presented as two explicit independent model records because its battlefield roles differ substantially despite the PDF expressing them through overlapping replacement clauses. Each model chooses one of three player-facing roles: Combi-weapon Terminator, Heavy Weapon Terminator, or Assault Terminator. Combi-weapon Terminators select one melee weapon plus one Combi package; the Combi packages use a single visible choice with hidden semantic child items, and Combi-Melta & Combi-Bolter costs +10. Heavy Weapon Terminators select one melee weapon plus Reaper Autocannon or Heavy Flamer. Assault Terminators select two independent melee weapons; choosing Lightning Claw in both lists represents paired Lightning Claws without a separate Lightning Claws option. By project convention, both Terminators may use identical roles and identical loadouts even where the PDF's one-model replacement language would ordinarily restrict that. Cyclone Missiles remains a single +20 Paid Wargear choice at unit level because the physical model makes its bearer unambiguous during play.
SHARED WEAPON IDS REV25: every repeated player-facing weapon/loadout in Chaos Terminators now links to one shared selection identity. This covers Chainfist, Power Fist, Power Weapon, Chainsword, Lightning Claw, the four Combi-weapon loadouts, Reaper Autocannon, and Heavy Flamer. All existing per-branch selection IDs are retained as entryLink IDs, so defaults and the builder hierarchy stay unchanged. Combined Combi loadouts are treated as the meaningful export leaf; their historical hidden semantic component groups are retained under the shared target but made optional so they do not auto-select. Lernaean Terminators and other Terminator units are intentionally unchanged.

categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Other Soft Copy Cost

sharedSelectionEntries.comment:
LOADOUT REV14: Chosen are 3-5 models at 40 Points per model. Pack your lunch? defaults to the normal manual builder. The manual branch exposes Chosen 1-3 as fixed model headers and optional Chosen 4-5 at +40 Points each. Chosen 1-2 include the source paid Combi-Bolter replacement packages in their ranged list; Chosen 3-5 do not. Every model independently selects one ranged and one melee weapon. By project convention, Lightning Claw is additionally offered in every ranged list, allowing the paired-claw state by selecting Lightning Claw in both lists and intentionally ignoring the PDF's one-model restriction because it does not alter the unit's total damage budget for project purposes. Frag Grenade and Krak Grenade remain independent +10 Paid Wargear choices in the manual branch.
SANDVICHES EASTER EGG: selecting Yes, please! constructs the five-model preset by adding +80 Points over the three-model base and presents Sandviches: > Chosen 1-5 > 5x Power Sword / 5x Plasma Pistol. The Power Sword label is an intentional player-specific presentation name for the source-generic Power Weapon. The lunch preset is a separate mutually-exclusive implementation branch rather than a modifier-driven attempt to auto-click the manual controls.

sharedSelectionEntries.name: Breacher Siege Squad

categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Other Soft Copy Cost

sharedSelectionEntries.comment:
LOADOUT REV21: the three-model base is presented as Breacher Champion, Breacher 2, and Breacher 3, with optional Breacher 4 and Breacher 5 at +40 Points each. Breacher Champion chooses one melee weapon (Chainsword / Power Weapon / Power Fist / Lightning Claw / Thunder Hammer), one ranged weapon (Boltgun / Bolt Pistol / Plasma Pistol / +10 Combi packages / +20 Combi-Melta package), and retains Boarding Shield. Boltgun is intentionally presented as a genuine Champion ranged option rather than merely an intermediary state in the PDF replacement grammar. Breacher 2 similarly chooses Boltgun / Flamer / Meltagun / Graviton Gun / Plasma Gun / Lascutter and retains Boarding Shield, explicitly presenting Boltgun as the ordinary legal state. Breacher 3 is fixed Boltgun + Boarding Shield. Additional Breachers use a compact Boltgun & Boarding Shield package with hidden semantic child items. Frag Grenades, Krak Grenades, and Breacher Charge are each optional +10 Paid Wargear. Existing Chaos Lord attachment eligibility, one-Leader host validation, root minimum cost, and Other copy-cost behavior remain unchanged.
SHARED GUN & SHIELD PACKAGES REV25: Breacher ranged equipment is now represented as one meaningful gun-plus-Boarding-Shield package. The Breacher Champion keeps its independent melee weapon choice, then chooses Boltgun / Bolt Pistol / Plasma Pistol / Combi loadout & Boarding Shield. Breacher 2 chooses Boltgun / Flamer / Meltagun / Graviton Gun / Plasma Gun / Lascutter & Boarding Shield. Breacher 3, Breacher 4, and Breacher 5 use Boltgun & Boarding Shield. Every identical Boltgun & Boarding Shield selection links to the same shared target, including the Champion and Breacher 2 option. Existing weapon/package IDs are retained as entryLink IDs, historical standalone Boarding Shield IDs remain hidden and optional, and Breacher 4/5 retain their existing model wrappers and +40 Points costs. Paid Wargear, attachments, root points, and copy-cost behavior are unchanged.

catalogue.comment:
GREAT TRAITORS' ARSENAL LIBRARY V1 / GS17.
Generated from Chaos Space Marines 3.3.5 REV26 as the reusable unit source for Great Traitors' Arsenal host catalogues. Contains the 28 mechanically portable generic Chaos Space Marines root units plus their shared weapon / loadout package dependencies and CSM-local attachment/counts-as categories. Legion-section units are excluded. The current main CSM listbuilder compiles Chaos Lord and Terminator Chaos Lord into Legion-specific player-facing entries, so those compiled Legion-bound versions are not exported into this reusable library. All copied unit-tree IDs are deliberately preserved so host entryLinks can target the same semantic unit identities and future library rebuilds can be diffed against the production CSM catalogue.
